activate SSH
    Open the Raspberry Pi Terminal.
    Enter the command: sudo raspi-config
    Use the arrow keys to navigate to Interfacing Options. Press the Enter key.
    Go to SSH, I2C, SPI, Serial and press enter.
    When prompted, select <Yes>.
    Select Enter to confirm, then click Finish to exit raspi-config.
    Close the terminal window.
        $ cd ~
        $ mkdir .ssh
        $ echo "ssh-rsa  rsa-key-20220116" >>  ~/.ssh/authorized_keys


How do I increase the size of swapfile without removing it in the terminal
    https://askubuntu.com/questions/927854/how-do-i-increase-the-size-of-swapfile-without-removing-it-in-the-terminal
        $ sudo swapoff /var/swap
        $ sudo dd if=/dev/zero of=/var/swap bs=1M count=1024 oflag=append conv=notrunc
        $ sudo mkswap /var/swap
        $ sudo swapon /var/swap
